## `groups list`

Retrieves the list of Groups with pagination (sorting and filtering)

```
epm-cli groups list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/Groups` · Response: `GroupListItemModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--id` | UUID |  | The Id of the group(Guid format), for example - 59A00329-87AC-49EC-BC2C-9B9E26F05185 |
| `--name` | string |  | The name of the group |
| `--description` | string |  | The description of the group |
| `--policy-name` | string |  | The policy name of the group |
| `--policy-revision-status` | string | `OnAssignedPolicy`, `AwaitingPolicyUpdate`, `NoPolicy` | The policy revision status of the group |
| `--computer-count` | integer |  | Number of computers in a group |
| `--active-computers-value` | integer |  | Integer value for the filter, e.g. 100 |
| `--active-computers-operator` | string | `EqualTo`, `LessThan`, `GreaterThan`, `LessThanOrEqualTo`, `GreaterThanOrEqualTo` | `Filter.ActiveComputers.Operator` |
| `--created-dates` | list of date-time |  | Valid date formats for filter - 2020-12-24, 2020-12-24 19:09:47, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562 +00:00 |
| `--created-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |
| `--default` | switch |  | `Filter.Default` |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli groups list --all -o json
```

## `groups create`

Creates Group

```
epm-cli groups create [flags]
```

API: `POST /v3/Groups`

**Request body** (JSON, `CreateGroupRequest`)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | `name` | string |  | name of the group, for example - Alianse Group |
| `--description` | `description` | string |  | description of the group, for example - Alianse Group Description |
| `--is-default` | `isDefault` | switch |  | – |

Other or nested fields: `--set path=value`, or pass the whole body with `--body` (inline, `@file.json` or `-` for stdin). Example body (`--body-template`):

```json
{
  "name": "",
  "description": "",
  "isDefault": false
}
```

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli groups create --name <VALUE>
```

| `--all-computers` | `allComputers` | switch |  | – |
| `--excluded-computer-ids` | `excludedComputerIds` | list of UUID |  | excluded computers Ids will only be applicable when "allComputers" is set to false. |
| `--selection-computer-ids` | `selectionComputerIds` | list of UUID |  | selection computers ids will work when "allComputers" : false |

## `groups assign-computers`

assigns computers to the group

```
epm-cli groups assign-computers <ID> [flags]
```

API: `POST /v3/Groups/{id}/AssignComputers`

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | id |

**Request body** (JSON, `AssignComputersToGroupRequest`)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--computer-ids` | `computerIds` | list of UUID |  | computer ids which will be assigned to the group |
| `--excluded-computer-ids` | `excludedComputerIds` | list of UUID |  | computer ids which will not be assigned to group excluded computers Ids will only be applicable when "allComputers" is set to false. |
| `--all-computers` | `allComputers` | switch |  | assigns all computers to the group |
